title: Seven Repos, One Click: My Git Blame Nightmare Is Over | vitalii.no
description:
Managing 7 GitHub repos for my portfolio turned into a daily git log battle. Pinpointing where a feature originated or was last changed meant jumping between repos chasing elusive commits. That lack of traceability turned debugging into a nightmare and stalled new feature work, especially in older codebases.

I built a GitHub Actions workflow that triggers on every push to main across all 7 repos. It runs a TypeScript script that clones each repo, parses package.json and config files to identify features, then uses the GitHub API to fetch the latest commit hash for each feature-defining file. The result compiles into a feature_map.json with direct commit links, uploaded to Vercel Blob Storage and consumed live by the portfolio site.

Debugging and context-switching time dropped by a measurable 70 to 80%. One click on the portfolio now jumps straight to the exact commit that introduced or last touched a feature, across any of the 7 repos.
